# Retired status-check contexts (issue #659).
#
# Each context here belonged to a job that re-proved what another job proves,
# so its assertion moved into that job. Branch protection on main may still
# require the context, and a required context that no job reports blocks
# every pull request and merge-queue run. So each keeps a stub job under the
# same name with `if: false`: it skips on every event, and a skipped job
# reports success without taking a runner.
#
# Same format as .github/required-checks.txt (one context per line; blank
# lines and `#` lines ignored). A context may not be in both files.
# tools/ci/check-required-checks.sh fails when a context here names no stub
# (a job whose job-level `if:` is `false`) that reports on pull requests and
# merge-group runs; `--live` lists the ones protection still requires.
#
# Retiring a context: move its line here from required-checks.txt and turn
# its job into a stub. A maintainer then removes it from protection (apply
# required-checks.txt, CONTRIBUTING.md "Required checks and review"); after
# that, delete the stub and its line here in a follow-up.

# c-cpp.yml `enablesec`: the ENABLESEC=1 compile is made by the shared
# enablesec SDK build of tests/run_all_tests.sh (rule_engine,
# installed_consumer) and by codeql.
enablesec
# c-cpp.yml `asan-build` (formerly phase0-baseline.yml): the BUILD=asan
# compile and `__asan_init` check are a step of
# sanitizer-tests (BUILD=asan, asan).
ASan/UBSan profile compiles
